system.description: The Stormkelt’s voice resounds with might and truth, affecting one chosen person within range. Everything the dimwalker says sounds believable, and the afflicted character must succeed on a Situation roll with a Situation value of 8 (Intelligence modifiers apply) to avoid complete acceptance of whatever the Stormkelt says.
